mechanics.title: Persistent contents
mechanics.description: Items remain in the anvil when the interface closes and are shown on the block.

mechanics.title: Anvil repair
mechanics.description: Use iron blocks on a damaged anvil to restore it; anvils are less likely to be damaged or break.

vanilla_changes.change: Reduced prior-work penalty, cheaper enchanted book application, fewer "too expensive" cases, free renaming.
Formatting codes allowed in item names.
Can be repaired with iron blocks.

getting_started: Right-click an anvil, place items, close it; they remain.
editor_notes: Exact numbers are config-driven and not in the facts. Needed on both sides. The pack ships a separate grindenchantments config; interplay unverified.
name: Easy Anvils
summary: Overhauls the anvil: items stay in it after closing the GUI and render on top, prior-work penalties and costs are much less restrictive, renaming is free and supports formatting codes, and anvils can be repaired with iron blocks and are more durable.
